A little about me

Find the human
in the system.

I'm Hazwan, a product designer
and creative developer.

Every product carries a lot beneath its surface: people's habits, a team's intentions, the choices that came before.

I work where those things meet. Research helps me understand the real question. Design gives it shape. Code lets me see how it feels.

Product system study 01 / 03

Northstar

Less searching.
More understanding.

A shared place for research and customer signals. This study explores how scattered observations can become a direction a team understands.

The question
How can a team see the signal without losing the story behind it?
The direction
Search around an intention. Keep evidence close to the insight. Make the next conversation easier.

Identity system study 02 / 03

Lumen

A small identity.
A world of possibility.

A portable identity study for a studio making thoughtful tools for teams. An open, recognisable mark gives the system a character that can move.

The question
How can an identity keep its character as its surroundings change?
The direction
One simple form, many expressions. A visual language that connects product, print, and motion.

Designed for the unfinished.Field Notes / Workspace study

Workspace study 03 / 03

Field Notes

Give a good question
somewhere to grow.

A flexible workspace study for teams who want to stay curious. Questions, observations, and half-formed ideas sit together, ready for the next conversation.

The question
What happens when a workspace makes room for the unfinished?
The direction
Capture lightly. Connect related thoughts. Return when an idea is ready to take shape.
